topic: K-Stick and the Map That Keeps Changing Its Mind
hook_text: K-Stick finally found a map... probably.

scenes.story_text: K-Stick unfolds the map, spots the red marker, and confidently points down the path as if he knows exactly where he is going.
He takes two steps, but the map suddenly flips its arrow around. K-Stick spins in place, following the new direction while his eyes grow wider.
The map changes again and points directly at K-Stick. He looks behind himself, expecting a destination, but finds nothing.
K-Stick proudly taps the map and says, "Found it!" The map reveals a tiny label on his cap reading "You are here," so he has been the destination the whole time.
